say:2:1029120001:2.text: Hey, Dora! How does it feel to be caught again?
say:2:1029120001:2.source_cn: 呦，朵拉，再被抓回来的感受如何？

say:3:1029120002:2.text: Hmph. I, for one, won't run away again. So take me home, and if I get grounded, then so be it...
say:3:1029120002:2.source_cn: 哼，我，反正我不会再偷跑了，你带我回家吧，关禁闭就关禁闭……

say:4:1029120003:1.text: You're suddenly acting so honest. You're not already scheming something again, are you...?
say:4:1029120003:1.source_cn: 你怎么这么老实？不会又在打什么坏主意吧……

say:6:1029120004:1.text: When we found Dora, she'd almost been caught by Hypofiends. She was so scared that she said she'd give up on joining the Shadow Chasers—
say:6:1029120004:1.source_cn: 我们见到朵拉的时候，她差点被魔物抓到。朵拉很害怕，她现...

say:8:1029120005:2.text: Hang on, you can't tell Mr. Valen about that!
say:8:1029120005:2.source_cn: 等等，你们……别和维伦先生说这个啊！

say:9:1029120006:1.text: The Shadow Chasers? Now, that does sound interesting. If I'm not mistaken, that seems like the dangerous group led by Makta and that lot, right?
say:9:1029120006:1.source_cn: “追影者”……听起来确实有趣。如果我没猜错的话，这个看...

say:11:1029120008:1.text: Because I know everything. I also know that, as a knight of justice, I can't just overlook such an evil group.
say:11:1029120008:1.source_cn: 我当然知道。我还知道，作为一名正义的骑士，我可不能放着...

say:12:1029120009:1.text: Tell me, what exactly do those Shadow Chasers do?
say:12:1029120009:1.source_cn: 说吧，你们这个“追影者”都干了什么事啊？

say:13:1029120010:1.text: They only research some legends about Hypogeans. For example, they say that they're stronger than Celestials—
say:13:1029120010:1.source_cn: 就是，就是研究了一些恶魔的传说。比如说在传说中，恶魔比...

say:14:1029120011:1.text: Because Celestials are demigods, right?! And if Hypogeans can fight like gods, then they can easily beat demigods.
say:14:1029120011:1.source_cn: 因为“半神”有一个“半”字在前面嘛！恶魔能和神打得不相...

say:16:1029120012:1.text: You don't get it! Celestials aren't weaker than Hypogeans. Weren't you just saved by Archon Scarlita?! She's a Celestial!
say:16:1029120012:1.source_cn: 你这完全是望文生义吧！半神才不会比恶魔弱呢，你之前不就...

say:17:1029120013:1.text: Of course, the Celestial who saved me was amazing! But Hypogeans just sound cooler! Even the name feels rebellious and dark!
say:17:1029120013:1.source_cn: 之前救我的半神大姐姐当然很厉害！可是恶魔就是感觉听起来...

choice_prompt:18:1029120013.text: Of course, the Celestial who saved me was amazing! But Hypogeans just sound cooler! Even the name feels rebellious and dark!
choice_prompt:18:1029120013.source_cn: 之前救我的半神大姐姐当然很厉害！可是恶魔就是感觉听起来更酷嘛！光是恶魔这个词一说出去，就有种叛逆，帅气，强大的感觉！

say:19:1029120014:2.text: It's nothing to do with age, okay?! And you've never seen a Hypogean, either.
say:19:1029120014:2.source_cn: 这个和年龄没有关系吧！你又没见过恶魔。

say:20:1029120016:1.text: Not only have we seen a Hypogean... You're looking at Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, who's even FOUGHT one!
say:20:1029120016:1.source_cn: 哼哼，这你可说到重点了，我们可不只是见过恶魔这么简单…...
say:20:1029120016:1.male: Not only have we seen a Hypogean... You're looking at Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, who's even FOUGHT one!
say:20:1029120016:1.female: Not only have we seen a Hypogean... You're looking at Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, who's even FOUGHT one!

say:21:1029120017:1.text: R-Really?! You've actually fought a Hypogean? That's so cool!
say:21:1029120017:1.source_cn: 真、真的吗！竟然和恶魔战斗过……这也太厉害了吧！

say:22:1029120018:1.text: Hard to imagine, right? The magister is very humble and doesn't like to brag. Why don't you all worship Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> instead?
say:22:1029120018:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，想不到吧？主人深藏不露的，还非常谦虚。不如你们追...
say:22:1029120018:1.male: Hard to imagine, right? The magister is very humble and doesn't like to brag. Why don't you all worship Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> instead?
say:22:1029120018:1.female: Hard to imagine, right? The magister is very humble and doesn't like to brag. Why don't you all worship Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> instead?

say:23:1029120019:1.text: Hey, Hammie! I know how much you adore <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but now is not the time to be recruiting fans.
say:23:1029120019:1.source_cn: 喂喂，漫漫小姐，虽然我理解你对<style=stres...
say:23:1029120019:1.male: Hey, Hammie! I know how much you adore <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but now is not the time to be recruiting fans.
say:23:1029120019:1.female: Hey, Hammie! I know how much you adore <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but now is not the time to be recruiting fans.

say:24:1029120020:1.text: Tell me the truth, Dora. Where is the base of the Shadow Chasers? As a member of the Heroic Order, I must eliminate such hidden dangers.
say:24:1029120020:1.source_cn: 朵拉，老实交代，你们这个危险组织“追影者”的基地，到底...

say:25:1029120021:1.text: ...I'm not gonna tell! If the group gets shut down, everyone in the Shadow Chasers will see me as a traitor!
say:25:1029120021:1.source_cn: ……我才不要告诉你呢！要是组织没了，追影者的大家肯定会...

choice_prompt:26:1029120021.text: ...I'm not gonna tell! If the group gets shut down, everyone in the Shadow Chasers will see me as a traitor!
choice_prompt:26:1029120021.source_cn: ……我才不要告诉你呢！要是组织没了，追影者的大家肯定会把我当成叛徒的！

say:27:1029120022:1.text: You may be right about that... No! No matter what, everyone's gonna hate me if I tell!
say:27:1029120022:1.source_cn: 这么说好像也没错……不对！不管怎么样，如果我说了，肯定...

say:28:1029120023:1.text: Think about it: what if the other members of Shadow Chasers are like you and put themselves in danger just because they want to see a Hypogean?
say:28:1029120023:1.source_cn: 你想想看，要是那些追影者的成员们也像你一样，因为想要见...

say:29:1029120024:1.text: You'd obviously be doing the right thing. How could you be hated when everyone in Holistone will be thanking you?
say:29:1029120024:1.source_cn: 你这明明是在做好事，怎么可能会被讨厌呢，圣石镇的大家都...

say:30:1029120025:1.text: Shut up! I'm not falling for it!
say:30:1029120025:1.source_cn: 你别说了，我不会上当的！

say:31:1029120026:1.text: *Sigh* I'd hoped it wouldn't get to this point, but since you're being so stubborn, I'm forced to play the ace up my sleeve.
say:31:1029120026:1.source_cn: 唉。我本来也不想走到这一步的。但既然你这么坚决，那我也...

say:32:1029120027:1.text: Let's go. We're gonna have a good talk with your parents about the Shadow Chasers.
say:32:1029120027:1.source_cn: 走吧，去找你爸妈，我们一起好好聊聊“追影者”的事情。

choice:26:0:1.text: But you haven't even joined them.
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 你不是还没加入追影者吗？
choice:26:0:1.male: But you haven't even joined them.
choice:26:0:1.female: But you haven't even joined them.

choice:26:1:2.text: You can't be counted as a traitor.
choice:26:1:2.male: You can't be counted as a traitor.
choice:26:1:2.female: You can't be counted as a traitor.

choice:18:0:1.text: You're just in your rebellious phase.
choice:18:0:1.male: You're just in your rebellious phase.
choice:18:0:1.female: You're just in your rebellious phase.

say:35:1029120015:1.text: How would you know what Hypogeans are like? Don't tell me you've seen one.
say:35:1029120015:1.source_cn: 你怎么会知道恶魔到底是什么样子的，难道你真见过？
